title: Quantity Selector
content: Create quantity selector input component. Structure: horizontal group with minus button, input, plus button. Buttons: w-10 h-10, Minus and Plus icons. Input: text-center, w-12. Styling: border rounded-lg, buttons with hover:bg-gray-100. Increment/decrement: plus adds 1, minus subtracts 1. Boundaries: minimum 1 (disable minus), maximum based on stock (disable plus). Direct input: allow typing, validate on blur.

variants.simple: Create quantity input with plus/minus buttons.
variants.detailed: Create quantity selector input component. Structure: horizontal group with minus button, input, plus button. Buttons: w-10 h-10, Minus and Plus icons. Input: text-center, w-12. Styling: border rounded-lg, buttons with hover:bg-gray-100. Increment/decrement: plus adds 1, minus subtracts 1. Boundaries: minimum 1 (disable minus), maximum based on stock (disable plus). Direct input: allow typing, validate on blur.
variants.advanced: Create quantity selector input component with validation and stock awareness. Structure: inline-flex items-center with border rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Minus button: w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center, Minus icon (w-4 h-4), hover:bg-gray-100 transition, disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:hover:bg-transparent. Input: text-center w-14 border-x border-gray-200 font-medium, type="text" with numeric validation (pattern="[0-9]*" inputMode="numeric"), remove spinner for type="number". Plus button: same styling as minus with Plus icon. Overall styling: border border-gray-200 rounded-lg, focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-black. Increment/decrement: plus adds 1, minus subtracts 1, with onClick handlers updating state. Boundaries: minimum 1 (disable minus button with disabled prop when value=1), maximum based on stock (disable plus when value=maxStock). Show "Max" indicator when at maximum. Direct input: allow typing quantity, validate on blur (parseInt, clamp between min and max), clear invalid input and reset to 1. Stock limit display: optional "Max 10" text label or tooltip on disabled plus. Update handling: for cart integration, debounce API calls (300ms), show optimistic UI update immediately, revert on error with toast notification. Loading state: subtle spinner or opacity during save. Delete on zero: option to trigger item removal if decremented below 1, show confirmation ("Remove item?" with Undo). Compact variant: smaller dimensions (w-8 h-8 buttons, w-10 input) for cart line items. Dropdown variant: for wholesale/bulk, use select dropdown with preset quantities (1, 5, 10, 25, 50). Keyboard: arrow up/down to increment/decrement when input focused, support keyboard navigation. Accessibility: group with aria-label "Quantity", buttons have aria-label "Decrease quantity" / "Increase quantity", input has aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax. Mobile: ensure adequate touch targets (44x44 minimum).
